tools.name: speechmatics_list_jobs
tools.description: List transcription jobs (most recent first), with status/data_name/duration. Batch API: GET /jobs.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_job
tools.description: Get a single job's details and status (running | done | rejected | deleted | expired). Poll this until status is "done", then fetch the transcript. Batch API: GET /jobs/{job_id}.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_transcript
tools.description: Get a completed job's transcript. format=txt (default, human-readable) | srt (subtitles) | json-v2 (structured words, timings, speakers, translations, summary). Only works once the job status is "done". Batch API: GET /jobs/{job_id}/transcript.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_job_log
tools.description: Get a job's plain-text processing log — useful for debugging a rejected job. Batch API: GET /jobs/{job_id}/log.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_usage
tools.description: Get usage statistics (transcription minutes) for the account over a date range. Batch API: GET /usage.

tools.name: speechmatics_transcribe_url
tools.description: Submit a publicly reachable audio/video URL for speech-to-text transcription (optionally with diarization, translation, and summarization). ASYNC: returns a job id immediately — poll speechmatics_get_job until status is "done", then call speechmatics_get_transcript. Batch API: POST /jobs.

tools.name: speechmatics_delete_job
tools.description: ⚠️ Permanently deletes a job and its transcript. Set force=true to delete even while it is still running. Batch API: DELETE /jobs/{job_id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: speechmatics_get_job, speechmatics_get_transcript · Public sink: speechmatics_transcribe_url · Destructive: speechmatics_get_transcript, speechmatics_delete_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: speechmatics_get_job, speechmatics_get_transcript · Public sink: speechmatics_transcribe_url · Destructive: speechmatics_get_transcript, speechmatics_delete_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
